title: Learning Graph-Conditioned Predictors in Weight Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.19250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The same node attributes can imply different labels in different structural contexts. Yet fast graphless models typically treat topology as additional evidence supplied to a globally shared predictor. This assumes that structure augments the available information, rather than determining how node attributes should be interpreted. We introduce SCOPE (Structure-COnditioned PrEdictor), in which a small generator maps each node's cached structural fingerprint to coefficients over a shared low-rank basis, producing a context-specific update to a global weight matrix. The base predictor, basis, and generator remain shared across all nodes, while the resulting transformation adapts how attributes are processed in each relational environment. Once fingerprints are cached, inference requires only a forward pass and no online message passing. translated_title: 在权重空间中学习图条件化预测器
translated_abstract: 相同的节点属性在不同的结构语境中可能隐含不同的标签。然而，快速的免图模型通常将拓扑结构视为提供给全局共享预测器的附加证据，这假定了结构只是补充可用信息，而非决定节点属性应如何被解读。我们提出SCOPE（结构条件化预测器，Structure-COnditioned PrEdictor），其中一个小型生成器将每个节点缓存的结构指纹映射为共享低秩基上的系数，从而对全局权重矩阵产生上下文特定的更新。基础预测器、基和生成器在所有节点间保持共享，而由此产生的变换则调整属性在每个关系环境中的处理方式。一旦缓存了指纹，推理仅需一次前向传播，无需在线消息传递。该设计将上下文特定的专门化与全局参数共享以及紧凑的低秩自适应相结合。
tldr: 提出SCOPE方法，通过小型生成器将节点缓存的结构指纹映射到共享低秩基上的系数，生成上下文特定的权重矩阵更新，使预测器能依据图结构解读节点属性，同时推理仅需一次前向传播、无需在线消息传递。
en_tdlr: SCOPE uses a small generator to map cached structural fingerprints to coefficients over a shared low-rank basis, producing context-specific updates to a global weight matrix so that node attributes are interpreted according to graph structure, with inference requiring only a forward pass and no online message passing.
